diffuseAlbedo.source: Vacek, Krivy, Kreislova, Vlachova, Kubzova, 'Experimental Measurement of Deposition Chloride Ions in the Vicinity of Road Cut', Materials (Basel) 16(1):88, Table 23, https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC9821097/
diffuseAlbedo.note: Verified as for steel (envelope green max recomputes to 0.073, not 0.074). This is a proxy. The rust measured is on a low-alloy weathering steel, not on Victorian cast or wrought iron. The first rust of any iron in air is the same lepidocrocite-goethite pair, but graphite in cast iron and slag in wrought iron may darken it. The museum's iron is painted, so this shows only where paint has failed.
diffuseAlbedo.derivation: As steel.tarnish.diffuseAlbedo: mean CIELAB (30.39, 10.05, 10.65) of five rusted Corten A coupons, D65 2-degree white, linear Rec.709. Envelope min [0.093, 0.037, 0.023], max [0.119, 0.073, 0.069].

refractiveIndex.source: webmineral.com Lepidocrocite and Goethite optical data, https://www.webmineral.com/data/Lepidocrocite.shtml , https://www.webmineral.com/data/Goethite.shtml ; phase fractions from Vacek et al., Materials 16(1):88 (PMC9821097), Table 31
refractiveIndex.note: As steel.tarnish.refractiveIndex; verified against both webmineral pages. The phase fractions come from rust on weathering steel, used here as a proxy for iron's first rust.
refractiveIndex.derivation: 0.75 x 2.217 (lepidocrocite mean principal index) + 0.25 x 2.375 (goethite mean principal index) = 2.256.
